title: Cap. IX Arg. 4: God is ready to give all sufficient media to believe and convert — therefore reprobation only by consequent will after foresight of final impenitence
pass_a_gloss: They urge still more strongly; God himself on his part is prepared to give unto all media sufficient and necessary unto believing and converting, and will doubtless give them unless they themselves put an obstacle: But these things seem to fight among themselves, that God by antecedent will should have reprobated someone, and yet be prepared to supply unto him all things necessary unto salvation: Therefore he reprobated no one except by consequent will the foresighted final impenitence, unbelief, and rejection of Divine grace of the same man.
pass_b_english: They press harder still: God on his part is ready to give everyone the media sufficient and needful for believing and converting, and will surely give them unless people themselves put up a barrier. But that seems to clash — that God by antecedent will should have reprobated someone, and yet be ready to supply him everything needful for salvation. Therefore, they say, he reprobated no one except by consequent will after foresight of that person's final impenitence, unbelief, and rejection of divine grace.
source_text: Urgent adhuc fortius; Deus ipse ex parte sua paratus est dare omnibus media sufficientia et necessaria ad credendum et convertendum, ac dabit proculdubio nisi obicem ipsi posuerint: Videntur autem haec inter se pugnare, ut Deus voluntate antecedente aliquem reprobaverit, et tamen paratus sit ei suppeditare omnia ad salutem necessaria: Neminem ergo reprobavit nisi voluntate consequente praevisam ejusdem hominis finalem impoenitentiam, infidelitatem, gratiaeque Divinae rejectionem.
